annotations.title: What's waiting to be sent to the stores

description: Every draft on the store setup, by store: the setup parts (App Store app information, age rating, price, release, App Review; Google Play's contact details) and the store listing per language, field by field. People and agents fill these; ploa_details_send takes them to the stores. Also the changes Ploa keeps while Apple has what they're for with App Review (a product's image, screenshots, text, an event…): Ploa sends those by itself once Apple has decided; ploa_held_changes lists them by language and sends them now.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_changes_get
